title: The illusion may have a function

statements.text: If consciousness involves an illusion, its function may be to give the impression of a magical, non-physical inner life. Humphrey’s account, in which internalized evaluative responses interact with sensory signals in monitored feedback loops, is one example, with the internal magic show shaped by natural selection.

sources.quote: Maybe its function is precisely to give us the impression that we have a magical, non-physical inner life.
